players.product: AI cloud computing power (GPU clusters on long-term contracts) and the StarFlow Model-as-a-Service platform; the strategic cloud platform of the Xiaomi and Kingsoft ecosystem

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration (20-F, customers not named): revenue from two customers accounted for 23% and 12% of total revenues in 2025 (16% and 10% in 2024; 15% and 12% in 2023). Premium Customers generated 98.3% of total revenues in 2025; the company had 473 Premium Customers with average revenue of RMB 14.6 million each, including 216 Public Cloud Service Premium Customers averaging RMB 30.3 million (19.7 million in 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: two customers 23% and 12% of 2025 revenue; Premium Customers 98.3% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Xiaomi (related party, 20-F): public cloud services provided to Xiaomi Group were RMB 1,853,124 thousand in 2025 (RMB 1,091,451 thousand in 2024) and enterprise cloud services to Xiaomi Group RMB 382,438 thousand; public cloud services provided to Kingsoft Group were RMB 363,300 thousand; total related-party revenue was RMB 2,620,919 thousand in 2025 (RMB 1,571,112 thousand in 2024). Kingsoft Cloud also purchased network hardware devices from Xiaomi Group (RMB 29,637 thousand in 2025).
quarterly_data.figure: Xiaomi Group public cloud RMB 1,853,124 thousand; related-party revenue RMB 2,620,919 thousand (2025)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue mix and infrastructure (20-F): total revenues RMB 9,558,619 thousand (RMB 7,785,180 thousand in 2024); public cloud services RMB 6,633,492 thousand, 69.4% of revenue (XBRL: +32.5% YoY); enterprise cloud services RMB 2,925,127 thousand (XBRL: +5.3% YoY). As of December 31, 2025 the company had approximately 101,500 servers and exabyte-level storage capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 9,558,619 thousand; public cloud RMB 6,633,492 thousand (+32.5%); ~101,500 servers

quarterly_data.signal: Capex and data-center capacity commitments (20-F): capital expenditures including those financed by third parties, primarily in connection with purchases of servers, networking equipment, property and other equipment and intangible assets, were RMB4,994.3 million (US$714.2 million) in 2025 versus RMB4,124.7 million in 2024. In 2025 the company entered into two non-cancelable internet data center service agreements with total contractual minimum purchase commitments of RMB1,280.0 million (US$183.0 million); the remaining purchase commitment was RMB587.2 million at December 31, 2025. It also has minimum purchase commitments with telecommunication operators to secure bandwidth.
quarterly_data.figure: capex RMB4,994.3 million (2025); IDC minimum purchase commitments RMB1,280.0 million
